title: The Hidden Night Shift
narration: Every night, while you lie still, your brain runs a cleanup crew, flushing out metabolic waste that could otherwise build up and harm you.
visual_goal: Close-up of a sleeping person, then a surreal tunnel inside the brain with glowing cleaning agents moving along pathways.

title: The 24-Hour Clock
narration: Inside your brain, a cluster of about twenty thousand neurons, the suprachiasmatic nucleus, sets your internal clock.
visual_goal: Animated 24-hour dial with a glowing core in the brain, neural pulses radiating out.

title: You Need 7 Hours
narration: Adults need at least seven hours of sleep per night. Not six, not five, that's the benchmark. Less than that? Your attention and working memory suffer, even after a single night.
visual_goal: Large bold '7' on screen, split screen showing sharp vs blurred thinking.

title: Your Brain's Wash
narration: This is where the glymphatic system comes in, a network of perivascular channels that flushes waste from the brain during sleep, clearing out metabolic byproducts.
visual_goal: Brain cross-section with blue fluid flowing through channels, flushing away orange waste particles.

title: More Than a Record
narration: The longest anyone has ever stayed awake? eleven days. Randy Gardner, a high schooler in nineteen sixty-four, pulled that off as a science project. But that's an extreme case.
visual_goal: Archival-style photo montage of a young man, clock ticking, then a dark somber frame.

title: Your Memory Feels It
narration: Even a single night of insufficient sleep impairs attention and working memory. Your focus wanders, your thoughts jump around, simple tasks start to feel harder. Sleep deprivation directly impairs attention and working memory.
visual_goal: Split screen: a sharp-minded person doing a puzzle vs a dazed person struggling.

title: Deep Waves
narration: Then comes deep sleep, with its slow, high-amplitude waves, when the day's experiences get processed and stored, think of it as your brain's nightly filing system.
visual_goal: An EEG line tracing low-frequency waves, then files being neatly sorted into a cabinet.

title: Dreams on REM
narration: Later, REM sleep follows, where your eyes dart, muscles go limp, and vivid dreams unfold.
visual_goal: Animated person with moving eyes under eyelids, dream imagery floating above the head.

title: Trim Your Synapses
narration: Your brain also prunes itself, trimming away unnecessary synaptic connections to maintain efficiency, keeping only those that are important. That's why you remember important things and forget the rest.
visual_goal: A neural garden where some synapses are snipped away neatly, others strengthened.

title: Protect Your Heart
narration: Skimp on sleep, and your heart suffers, your whole body does. Insufficient sleep has been associated with increased risks of obesity, diabetes, and cardiovascular disease.
visual_goal: A tired person holding their chest, then a rising sun over a vibrant landscape of a healthy sleeper.
